page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; page number at top left. No margin notes.

main_text.head: LV.
main_text.p: Psalmo LV. Glorifica nomen tuum super nos, ut cognoscamus, quoniam in secundum misericordiam tuam.
main_text.head: LVI.
main_text.p: Psalmo LVI. Tu es anchora spei, portus indulgentiae, & janua salutis.
main_text.head: LVII.
main_text.p: Psalmo LVII. Ad laudē & gloriam pertinet Salvatoris, quicquid honorificum impensum fuerit suae genitrici.
main_text.head: LVIII.
main_text.p: Psalmo LVIII. Eripe me ab inimicis meis, Domina mund: exurge in occursum meum, Regina pietatis.
main_text.head: LIX.
main_text.p: Psalmo LIX. Deus repulisti nos propter peccata nostra, & misericors es nobis propter virginem Mariam. Intercede pro nobis salutifera mater Dei.
main_text.head: LX.
main_text.p: Psalmo LX. Esto mihi Domina turris fortitudinis. Me tuearis a facie crudelis vastatoris.
main_text.head: LXI.
main_text.p: Psalmo LXI. Nonne Domina tibi subjecta erit anima mea, quae salvatorem omnium genuisti? Memento nostri, perditorum salvatrix. Infunde gratiam de thesauris

page.notes: Running head and headings are partly obscured by stains; some words in the headings (e.g. "LV", "LVI") and the Psalm verses are read with uncertainty. The last line is partly cut off at the foot.
